problem_statement:

**Describe the issue**
We use the checkov serverless checks in our github actions ci/cd and as of yesterday (Monday Dec, 9 2024) it crashes trying to run when we use the latest release https://github.com/bridgecrewio/checkov/releases/tag/3.2.334

We pinned to the previous version which was working for us: https://github.com/bridgecrewio/checkov/releases/tag/3.2.332 through the github action:
`bridgecrewio/checkov-action@v12` -> `bridgecrewio/checkov-action@v12.2932.0`
